ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR22] Requires Up-Sell Oracle Account ID# on moving into Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification, non-ITAD non-NA deals. Simplified per IRM; 'ITAD' now literal (confirmed live value).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'),
AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'ITAD')), Region__c <> 'North America' ),
OR( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ) ),
ISBLANK(IM_Up_Sell_Sold_To__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Up-Sell Oracle Account ID# is required. Please enter Up-Sell Oracle Account ID#.
